name: Spain
eraRationale: This span captures Spain's consolidation under Ferdinand and Isabella, its transatlantic expansion, and the imperial confidence that defined the Spanish Golden Age.

moments.title: The last kingdom falls
moments.factText: Granada surrendered to Ferdinand II and Isabella I in January 1492, ending the Nasrid kingdom in Iberia.
moments.narrativeCopy: Spain's story shifted in 1492 as institutions, ambition, and empire converged around this moment. The fact stays fixed; the tone reframes it for a visual narrative.
moments.detailCopy: A city changed hands, a centuries-old polity ended, and the balance of power on the peninsula was remade. Explore this moment through the places, objects, and people who inhabited it.

moments.location: Palos de la Frontera, Crown of Castile
moments.factText: Christopher Columbus departed in August 1492 under the patronage of the Catholic Monarchs and reached the Caribbean that October.
